items.author: Keylin2935
items.body:
### Description

Bug description
The Kilo Code extension consistently terminates API requests to local LLM providers (tested with both Ollama and LM Studio) after a fixed 300-second (5-minute) timeout. This timeout appears to be hardcoded and is not affected by any attempted configurations in settings.json.

This behavior makes it impossible to use powerful local models (like QWEN3-coder) for complex tasks, as their inference time can legitimately exceed 5 minutes.

Environment
Kilo Code Version: 4.70.2 on vscode
Operating System: macOS
Hardware: MacBook Pro M4 Max, 64GB RAM
Local LLM Provider
items.title: Hardcoded 300-second API timeout makes local LLMs (Ollama/LM Studio) unusable
